manual.why: the site's own stylesheet is compiled by `uxdsl build`, which runs the PostCSS plugin — there is no `import` of it to find

the /docs/diagnostics page renders UXD_* errors that scripts/capture-capabilities.js captured by running the real `uxdsl build` on broken sources and themes (and re-checks in npm test, failing when a case stops producing its code); /docs/runtime produces UXD_THEME_NOT_INITIALIZED and UXD_THEME_STRUCTURE live in its sandbox. A text search cannot tell a captured diagnostic from a typed one, so the pointer is the captured file.

the green, purple and slate theme overrides declare the packaged schema as their $schema, so an editor validates and completes them; scripts/test-theme-inheritance.cjs resolves the export and checks each pointer reaches it. A JSON $schema is not an import, so the detector cannot see it.
